assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production pixel RPG HAIR LAYERS on an IMMUTABLE SMALL SCALP RIG. Image1 is the EXACT target placement and size guide: 8 columns x3 rows, each cell is native48x48 enlarged6x. Directions each row FRONT, FRONT-LEFT, LEFT PROFILE, BACK-LEFT, BACK, BACK-RIGHT, RIGHT PROFILE, FRONT-RIGHT. The cyan curved crown outline is a HARD SCALE GUIDE, not a hair shape to copy as a rectangle. At native scale skull is16-17px wide; the fitted hair crown is ONLY20-21px wide, no more than4px above skull top. The SAME snug crown size and fixed ear/forehead roots in ALL THREE STYLES. The other three images show ONLY hairstyle/color inspiration, do NOT copy their oversized crown dimensions. Row1 dark walnut short softly side-swept hair; row2 elegant SILVER softly swept medium-short hair; row3 smooth brown tied ponytail, modest low tie at back, flowing tail behind neck/shoulder. Draw polished cohesive natural curved locks and broad crisp pixel shading, compact rounded scalp fit, tasteful asymmetrical fringe and temple locks. Hair must form ONE continuous opaque scalp cap, no holes, no bald cracks, no floating pieces, no huge coiffure, no mushroom volume, no tiny frizzy spikes, no flat cropped box top. Paint to hug the exact provided skull and make the forehead opening align to the existing eyes/ears; never move the eyes or head, never cover chin. Only the freely hanging ponytail below ear level may extend outside the crown guide. OUTPUT HAIR ONLY with actual transparent background: remove ALL faces, skin, ears, necks and cyan guidelines from final output, leaving precisely registered hair in the SAME cells. Preserve only the small green/magenta corner registration squares. Absolutely no skin pixels, no face drawings, no body, no text, no scenery, no extra guides. The alpha opening must reveal the original exact guide face when overlaid at the same position; do not resize individual hair bounding boxes.
